scope: native Linux child lifecycle then bounded synthetic container dictionary resources only; no UI, packaging, release or main

container.proof: readonly cgroup and identity checks plus at most 1 MiB; kernel limit only covers container processes, not host image pull or daemon; successful post-job container removal must be independently checked in complete runner logs

environment_boundaries.authority: standard GitHub-hosted non-privileged job.container only; no additional GitHub permissions, registry credentials, user volumes or Docker API access
environment_boundaries.before_checkout: UID/GID/saved IDs=1001, all capabilities=0, NoNewPrivs=1, seccomp filter, Docker socket inaccessible by effective identity, private read-only cgroup2 memory.max=2147483648 and memory.swap.max=0
environment_boundaries.host_operations: no sudo/chown/host cgroup writes/migration/mount changes/Docker API; only reviewed owned synthetic children plus Go compiler/test binary; no real data or credentials
environment_boundaries.probe: reuse reviewed tiny environment guard; delta may be zero, never claim positive observed memory charge
environment_boundaries.initialization: exact public GitHub run-attempt/job started_at establishes initialization-inclusive 600-second cap, with 180-second cleanup reserve; unavailable or mismatched metadata is NOT RUN
environment_boundaries.cleanup_acceptance: full official Stop containers log must confirm deletion and no Docker rm failure warning; green job alone is insufficient
environment_boundaries.future_large_workload: enabled diagnostics-only candidate; existing guards unchanged; remote ref creation and execution require separately assigned root approval and heavy slot
environment_boundaries.oom_group_zero: not equivalent to group=1; any OOM, timeout, absent completion or cleanup evidence fails closed; whole-container runner removal is independently verified platform fallback, not a guarantee of immediate owned-tree cleanup
